measurements.method: PIL mean RGB + Rec.709 luma over boxes on shots/r10 (x0,y0,x1,y1 at 1280x720, 844x390 for phone)

fixes.problem: street_sgt: the r10 swap to low-poly kit cars (parked.js line 36) replaced the scanned sedans of r9 with flat-shaded, untextured boxes: faceted wheel arches, flat painted wheels, no glass reflection, no trim or chrome, a pastel salmon coupe with flat white headlights. The cropped blue estate fills the bottom-right quarter. It reads like a 2005 game and is the worst near-camera asset in the round. The floating red block is gone, which was the reason for the swap.
fixes.fix: Two-level LOD in parked.js: slots within 45 m of any road-level views.json camera or of the player spawn zone (or simply, at runtime, the nearest 12 slots to the camera, re-picked every 2 s) use the scanned models.js meshes (one shared matrix per slot for all parts, which also prevents the orphan tail-light block). Kit cars only beyond 45 m. On the kit car itself: car paint roughness 0.35 -> 0.18, clearcoat 1.0, envMapIntensity 1.0 -> 0.7 in shade; glass material roughness 0.05, color #0d1218; wheels: dark tyre #1a1a1a plus a separate rim with metalness 1.0; bevel the body box edges (0.04 m). Also skip slots within 9 m of a road-level shot camera so no car is cropped by the frame edge.

fixes.problem: The mauve fix worked in the hero (upper-left sky 127,126,137 -> 106,118,141), but every wide view now has a deep noon-cobalt zenith at 18:00: bridge_skyline 41,101,161, river_cbd 49,98,152, kings_park 74,132,184 against the bible golden sky-high #8AA8CF (138,168,207). Blue/red ratio is ~3.9 vs 1.5 in the bible. Together with cream-white sunlit facades, bridge_skyline and kings_park read as 3 pm rather than golden hour.
fixes.fix: daycycle.js keyframes: el 8 zen [0.05,0.16,0.38] -> [0.085,0.165,0.32]; el 20 zen [0.05,0.165,0.44] -> [0.075,0.17,0.40]; el 0.5 zen [0.035,0.08,0.19] -> [0.05,0.085,0.18]. Keep sky.js line 93 hgt mix(4.2,6.5,sunset) (that fixed the mauve band). Target: kings_park and bridge_skyline upper sky in 110-140,140-165,185-210.

fixes.area: near inlet still a grey sky mirror; noon inlet pool-cyan
fixes.problem: The SEA_REFL distance blend landed (sea.js line 336, mix(0.6,0.88,...)), yet hero near inlet is 110,110,115, no teal at all (bible #2A566E = 42,86,110). At a 1.85 m eye height the near water is seen at 4-10 deg grazing, so Fresnel already sends most of the radiance to the reflection before the planar mix; the body colour never wins. At noon the same water goes light cyan 98,128,148 (hero_noon), close to the 'cyan swimming-pool water' avoid entry.
fixes.fix: sea.js SEA_REFL: scale the near reflection by a grazing-aware body weight: float nearK = 1.0 - smoothstep(8.0, 120.0, dist); radiance = mix(radiance, min(pr, vec3(60.0)), mix(0.6, 0.88, smoothstep(40.0, 250.0, dist)) * (1.0 - 0.35 * nearK)); then add the body: radiance += uSeaBody * nearK * 0.5 with uSeaBody linear [0.020,0.075,0.105]. world/index.js sea scatter [0.006,0.026,0.034] -> [0.007,0.030,0.040] and absorption red +25% so noon water darkens from cyan to #2F6A88 (47,106,136). Target hero inlet 60-80,80-95,95-110.

fixes.problem: Roads unchanged for two rounds: street_sgt 57,66,83 and shops 58,67,84 (B-R +26); hero shade pavers 39,39,49 (B-R +10). Bible asphalt #3A3D42 (B-R +8). splitShadow in src/art.js was moved to [0.90,1.0,1.08] (still a pure blue push), not the teal value proposed, and the neutral-guard on the split weight was not added.
fixes.fix: src/art.js grade.splitShadow [0.90,1.0,1.08] -> [0.92,1.02,1.03]. Post grade shader (src/cookbook/post/pipeline.js grade pass): attenuate the split on low-saturation pixels: float sg = smoothstep(0.04, 0.25, satOf(c)); t *= mix(vec3(1.0), mix(uSplitS, uSplitH, smoothstep(0.03,0.65,ls)), mix(0.35, 1.0, sg)). world/index.js road tint: reduce blue of the asphalt albedo by 10% (setRGB(1.85,1.72,1.52) -> (1.85,1.72,1.37)). Target road B-R <= +10.

fixes.area: hero palms read as dead straw
fixes.problem: hero, hero_back, phone_hud: the inlet Washingtonias are the most visible vegetation in the game, and backlit their crowns glow pale straw/bleached white (fronds fm.color 0xb4bca0 with trans 0.16, props.js line 161) with only ~10 thin fronds each, so they read as dead palms on sticks. The bible asks for dense palms with a warm rim, not white crowns. They are also all on the camera-right side.
fixes.fix: props.js line 161: fm.color 0xb4bca0 -> 0x7d8a58; foliagePatch trans 0.16 -> 0.10 and tint the transmitted light by the leaf albedo (trans colour = albedo*1.4, not white). palmGeo: frond count +60% (with 2 drooping skirt fronds of dead-brown 0x6b5a40 under the crown), frond length x1.15. Add 4 more eqPalms on the camera-left promenade (alongShore spacing 17 -> 13 m) with the views.json guard (reject trunk screen x 0.2-0.8 for player views).

fixes.problem: street_sgt and shops: shop bays are still flat grey roller-door panels (133,139,144) with no doors, interiors or merchandise, and every fascia carries the same dash glyph at a fixed pitch. facade.js shop branch is byte-identical to r7: shutter step(0.9,hu2) line 126, glyph sx*3.1 line 144, transK 0.65 line 197, gl *= 0.8 line 200.
fixes.fix: facade.js: line 126 step(0.9,hu2) -> step(0.95,hu2); line 197 shop transK 0.65 -> 0.85; line 200 gl *= 0.8 -> 0.5; shop day room gain 0.38 -> 0.65; dark door bay: if (fcH(cell+5.1) > 0.72) { room *= 0.12; glass *= 0.4; }; interior depth cue: room *= mix(0.55, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, sy)) (floor darker than ceiling) plus a lit counter band at sy 0.25-0.32. Glyph pitch sx*3.1 -> sx*mix(2.2,4.6,hu) and glyph count per fascia 3-9 so signs differ.

fixes.area: promenade emptied by the crowd fix
fixes.problem: Clipping and clumping are fixed (hero, hero_noon, hero_night: no interpenetration, no bodies in the bench), but the visible walkers on the promenade fell from 8 (r9) to 3 in hero and 1 in phone_hud. Golden hour at Elizabeth Quay in late November is busy; the bible lists 'empty streets' as a negative. street_sgt has ~4 tiny far walkers, shops 0.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.topUp: keep the new separation (>= 3.5 m) and bench reject, but raise the in-view target on high from ~3 to 7 and on low from ~1 to 3, using depth bins 8-16 / 16-30 / 30-60 m with max 2/2/3. Add 2-3 stationary 'idle' peds (leaning on the railing at the coping, sitting on benches facing the water: sit pose, bench centre + 0.05 m seat height) so the crowd is not all walkers. sgt zone busy count 14 -> 22, prime by view depth 12-90 m.

Sun/shade luma ratio 3.45 in sRGB, which is ~14:1 in linear: far harsher than the 5:1 fill ratio in the bible. lookPower 1.15 -> 1.08 and contrast 0.24 -> 0.2 landed; env at el 8 is 1.9. fixes.area: near-plane clip column (5th round) and palm through pavilion roof
fixes.problem: shops: an ~8 px pale column at the right edge (124,130,137 vs 96,108,119 beside it), present since r6. hero_back: a palm trunk pierces the red pavilion roof at Barrack Square (x ~990, y ~170-330). Also hero_night tower windows are large hard-edged tiles with stair-step edges.

fixes.area: phone HUD rest state and triangle headroom
fixes.problem: phone_hud: the ENTER ring fix landed (dimmed correctly). The zone title card and full health/stamina bars still sit over the sky at rest. The low tier is at 1.98M tris, 99% of the 2M budget, leaving no headroom for the extra peds or palms requested above.

fixes.area: phone HUD panels over the focal sky
fixes.problem: phone_hud: the minimap (opaque), the 'Elizabeth Quay / PERTH CBD' card and two full-strength bars take ~12% of the top band; the four touch buttons use heavy dark-brown fills that read as stickers over the sunlit pavers.
fixes.fix: ui.css: minimap opacity 1.0 -> 0.85 and 1 px border at rgba(255,255,255,.35); .tc-btn background rgba(40,30,25,.55) -> rgba(20,20,24,.35), ring 2 px -> 1.5 px, resting opacity 0.75 (1.0 on press). Keep labels at >= 12 css px with a 1 px text-shadow for contrast.

fixes.problem: hero/hero_back: the player and walkers get no visible warm rim from the low back-light (bible rim #FFC890 on characters), so the backlit player is a dark flat silhouette (player luma 56 in hero). hero_night: every walker is lit evenly head to toe regardless of lamp distance, so they look pasted on. Walkers' faces are unreadable at 15-30 m but that is acceptable; poses are stiff mid-stride snapshots with arms close to the body.
fixes.fix: avatars.js / character.js: add a view-dependent rim term in the character material: rim = pow(1.0 - max(dot(N, V), 0.0), 3.0) * max(dot(-V, sunDir), 0.0) * sunColor * 0.6 (golden hour only, scaled by sun elevation < 20 deg). Night: lampReceive(m, 1.6) -> lampReceive(m, 1.0) for walkers, player keeps a separate fill so player luma stays >= 45. Randomise walker animation phase and playback rate 0.9-1.1 so no two share a pose.

regressions.what: Parked cars swapped from scanned sedans to untextured low-poly kit cars: near cars in street_sgt are faceted, flat-shaded and toy-like; the cropped blue estate fills the lower-right quarter.
Promenade crowd overcorrected: visible walkers in hero fell from 8 to 3 and in phone_hud to 1; the EQ golden-hour plaza now reads empty.
Wide-view golden-hour sky went from warm haze to a saturated noon cobalt zenith (41,101,161), so bridge_skyline and kings_park lost their golden-hour read.

improvements.what: Walker clipping through benches and walker interpenetration fixed; walkers spaced, feet and shadows grounded.
Hero sky mauve band gone: upper-left sky 127,126,137 -> 106,118,141 (blue with amber kept low).
Golden shade lifted slightly: hero shade luma ~33 -> 40.
Kings Park scarp lawn: even rows replaced by sparser groves; hill canopy denser and darker.
Floating red block at the kerb gone.
Phone ENTER button now correctly dimmed when no vehicle is in reach.
Near-water reflection distance blend landed in sea.js (not yet visible as teal; see fix).
